Docs.summary: Provides parameters, capabilities, and measurement data for Wi-Fi round-trip time (RTT) ranging.

remarks.para: Use for Wi-Fi Neighbor Awareness Networking (NAN) RTT sessions. Its service name and match filter identify peers or services for discovery. Use for station-to-access-point RTT sessions, identified by the access point's basic service set identifier (BSSID).
reports NAN-RTT hardware capabilities. A periodic-ranging setting requests use of the feature; it does not establish hardware support. contains additional measurement data.

format.a: Android definitions of Wi-Fi RTT ranging parameters, capabilities, and data.
